1: // Neon Runner – simple infinite runner using the canvas with id="game"
2: // Controls: Arrow Up (jump), Arrow Down (slide)
3: // The player is a rectangle; obstacles are simple rectangles.
4: 
5: (() => {
6:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
7:   if (!canvas) {
8:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
9:     return;
10:   }
11:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
12:   // Resize canvas to fill the window
13:   const resize = () => {
14:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
15:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
16:     generateStars();
17:   };
18:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
19:   resize();
20: 
21:   // Game constants
22:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
23:   const JUMP_VELOCITY = -12;
24:   const SLIDE_TIME = 500; // ms
25:   const OBSTACLE_SPEED = 6;
26:   const OBSTACLE_INTERVAL = 1500; // ms
27: 
28:   // Player state
29:   const player = {
30:     width: 40,
31:     height: 80,
32:     x: 100,
33:     y: 0,
34:     vy: 0,
35:     onGround: false,
36:     sliding: false,
37:     slideTimer: 0,
38:     color: '#0ff',
39:   };
40: 
41:   // Obstacles and stars
42:   const obstacles = [];
43:   const stars = [];
44:   function generateStars() {
45:     stars.length = 0;
46:     const starCount = Math.min(200, Math.floor(canvas.width * canvas.height / 20000));
47:     for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
48:       stars.push({
49:         x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
50:         y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
51:         radius: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
52:       });
53:     }
54:   }
55:   generateStars();
56: 
57:   // Spawn obstacles
58:   function spawnObstacle() {
59:     const type = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'low' : 'high'; // low: jump over, high: slide under
60:     const width = 30 + Math.random() * 20;
61:     const height = type === 'low' ? 30 : 120;
62:     const y = type === 'low'
63:       ? canvas.height - height
64:       : canvas.height - player.height - 20;
65:     obstacles.push({ x: canvas.width + width, y, width, height, type, passed: false });
66:   }
67: 
68:   // Audio helpers
69:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
70:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
71:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
72:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
73:     osc.type = 'sine';
74:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
75:     osc.connect(gain);
76:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
77:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
78:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
79:     osc.start(audioCtx.currentTime);
80:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
81:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000 + 0.02);
82:   }
83:   const playJumpSound = () => playTone(600, 100);
84:   const playSlideSound = () => playTone(300, 150);
85:   const playCrashSound = () => playTone(100, 300);
86: 
87:   // Input handling
88:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
89:     if (e.code === 'ArrowUp' && player.onGround && !player.sliding) {
90:       player.vy = JUMP_VELOCITY;
91:       player.onGround = false;
92:       playJumpSound();
93:     }
94:     if (e.code === 'ArrowDown' && !player.sliding && player.onGround) {
95:       player.sliding = true;
96:       player.slideTimer = SLIDE_TIME;
97:       player.height = 40; // reduced height while sliding
98:       playSlideSound();
99:     }
100:   });
101: 
102:   let lastTime = 0;
103:   let obstacleTimer = 0;
104:   let score = 0;
105:   let gameOver = false;
106: 
107:   function update(dt) {
108:     if (gameOver) return;
109:     // Player physics
110:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
111:     player.y += player.vy;
112:     const groundY = canvas.height - player.height;
113:     if (player.y >= groundY) {
114:       player.y = groundY;
115:       player.vy = 0;
116:       player.onGround = true;
117:     }
118:     // Slide timer
119:     if (player.sliding) {
120:       player.slideTimer -= dt;
121:       if (player.slideTimer <= 0) {
122:         player.sliding = false;
123:         player.height = 80; // restore height
124:       }
125:     }
126:     // Obstacles logic
127:     obstacleTimer += dt;
128:     if (obstacleTimer >= OBSTACLE_INTERVAL) {
129:       obstacleTimer = 0;
130:       spawnObstacle();
131:     }
132:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
133:       const o = obstacles[i];
134:       o.x -= OBSTACLE_SPEED;
135:       // Collision detection
136:       if (!o.passed &&
137:           player.x < o.x + o.width &&
138:           player.x + player.width > o.x &&
139:           player.y < o.y + o.height &&
140:           player.y + player.height > o.y) {
141:         playCrashSound();
142:         gameOver = true;
143:       }
144:       // Score when passing
145:       if (!o.passed && o.x + o.width < player.x) {
146:         o.passed = true;
147:         score++;
148:       }
149:       // Remove off‑screen obstacles
150:       if (o.x + o.width < 0) {
151:         obstacles.splice(i, 1);
152:       }
153:     }
154:   }
155: 
156:   function render() {
157:     // Background gradient
158:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
159:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
160:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#004');
161:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
162:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
163: 
164:     // Draw player with neon glow
165:     ctx.shadowColor = player.color;
166:     ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
167:     ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
168:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.width, player.height);
169:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
170: 
171:     // Draw stars
172:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
173:     for (const s of stars) {
174:       ctx.beginPath();
175:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
176:       ctx.fill();
177:     }
178: 
179:     // Draw obstacles with neon outline
180:     for (const o of obstacles) {
181:       ctx.shadowColor = '#f0f';
182:       ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
183:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f0f';
184:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.width, o.height);
185:       ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
186:     }
187: 
188:     // UI – score
189:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
190:     ctx.font = '20px monospace';
191:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 20, 30);
192: 
193:     // Game over overlay
194:     if (gameOver) {
195:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
196:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
197:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f55';
198:       ctx.font = '48px monospace';
199:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
200:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
